convertibility_reason: Uses external .mqh libraries (Martingail.mqh, OnTesterFunctions.mqh) for money management and tester metrics. Martingale position sizing logic is encapsulated in the Martingail class requiring manual porting.

long.detail: MACD1 main line turns up: t[0]>t[1] && t[1]<t[2] (V-bottom on MACD1) AND MACD2 main line rising: k[1]>k[0]

short.detail: MACD1 main line turns down: t[0]<t[1] && t[1]>t[2] (V-top on MACD1) AND MACD2 main line falling: k[1]<k[0]

other_exits: No explicit close logic; exits only via SL/TP. Martingale class may manage lot doubling on loss via global variables.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Martingail class provides lt.Lot(). Shape (DML) sets deposit fraction for initial lot. DoublingCount (Ud) controls how many times lot is doubled after consecutive losses. Lot size read/written from global variables.

custom_logic_notes: Dual MACD confirmation: MACD1 (5,20,3) looks for V-bottom/V-top reversal pattern using 3 bars of main line values; MACD2 (10,15,3) confirms direction with momentum comparison between last 2 bars. New bar guard uses tick_volume>1 filter (only trades on first tick of bar). Martingale lot sizing persists across restarts via global variables (GVarName='MG_1'). OnTester custom metric: profitc_divide_lossc / (max_series_loss + 1), returns 0 if Tp<Stop.
python_conversion_notes: Martingail.mqh must be manually ported: implements global-variable-persisted martingale lot sizing with deposit fraction (Shape) and doubling count. OnTesterFunctions.mqh provides profitc_divide_lossc() and max_series_loss() for custom backtest metric - not needed for live trading but useful for optimization. Entry logic uses 3-bar MACD1 reversal + 2-bar MACD2 momentum confirmation - straightforward to replicate with pandas/numpy. SL/TP are in raw points (Stop*Point(), Tp*Point()) - ensure proper pip-to-point conversion for 5-digit brokers. The tick_volume>1 new-bar guard is an MT5-specific approximation; in Python use proper bar boundary detection.
